purpose: Assess significance separately from proof correctness and historical priority. Reconcile against the focused fresh literature reports before delivery.
bottom_line: A major contribution is not established by the present evidence. Some results may be meaningful specialist conjecture answers if their arguments survive human review and priority checks. These are mathematical refinements, not demonstrated advances in physical cone-energy minimization.

targets.baseline: General spiral-forest existence is explicitly conjectural in Tevet2025; Adiceam-Tsokanos2022 had conjectured nonexistence. Finite irrationally rotated lattice forests are established prior art.
targets.our_delta: A classical circle-discrepancy estimate, norm ranking and an o(1)-displacement stability argument impose exact sqrt(k) radii while preserving all-segment visibility.
targets.assessment: Strong candidate for a useful specialist conjecture resolution if correct and not already known; not a major dense-forest breakthrough without an improvement in the harder quantitative/Danzer directions.
targets.scope_limit: Not a constant-angle Fermat forest, not a Danzer set, no explicit optimal visibility rate, and no uniform-discreteness result.

targets.baseline: Bacher2014 gives local affine lattices and covolume pi. Tevet2025 classifies limits for one fixed BA angle but explicitly asks whether every target lattice occurs for some such angle. Winning-set and continued-fraction symbolic machinery is classical.
targets.our_delta: For each arbitrary covolume-pi lattice, choose one fixed BA angle realizing the target and its rotations/affine translates by actual translations only; the angle and digit bound may depend on target shape.
targets.assessment: A potentially substantive specialist existence result and worthwhile candidate for external review; not established as a major breakthrough or a new Diophantine-dynamics method.
targets.scope_limit: Not one BA angle realizing all lattice shapes, no target-independent digit bound, no physical optimality, no effective algorithm for arbitrary real target data.

targets.baseline: Higher-dimensional spiral Delone existence is already known. The Adiceam-Tsokanos2021 public manuscript separately asks for asymptotic density in n>=3.
targets.our_delta: Norm-ranked Z^n yields exact k^(1/n) radii, Delone separation/covering and density 1/V_n on every bounded Jordan region for each fixed n>=2.
targets.assessment: Potentially a useful short construction answering the additional density question; the method uses standard discrepancy and perturbation facts rather than establishing higher-dimensional existence for the first time.
targets.scope_limit: Arbitrary directions, not a fixed-angle analogue or a new optimal packing; unresolved older radial-enumeration source overlap remains.

targets.baseline: Bacher2014 Theorem1.1 and Remark3.3 already supply the uniform local-lattice model and exact area pi.
targets.our_delta: Apply fixed-covolume planar lattice degeneration, affine recentering and CF subsequences to get only affine lines or covolume-pi lattices as nonempty limits, excluding Z x R and the plane; realize empty/line/lattice types for each non-BA irrational angle.
targets.assessment: A classical corollary/completion and useful clarification of a recent question; low evidence for a major standalone contribution.
targets.scope_limit: Excluding Z x R refutes suggested attainability, not the weaker conjectured containment. Bacher's overlap must be prominent.

targets.baseline: The2018 paper suggests a three-super-soliton integrability test but does not state our square-free independent mixed-seed ansatz. Existing two-tau bosonic results and the2026 single-tau classification must be compared carefully.
targets.our_delta: Body projection retaining external theta transfers an all-degree F-F-G compatibility obstruction, excluding the selected generic family for all n>=4 despite nilpotent dressings.
targets.assessment: A narrow no-go/certification, possibly a useful correction of an overoptimistic test; not a resolution of the source's symmetry-integrability hypothesis.
targets.scope_limit: Restricted supersolitons, other ansatze, Lax pairs and generalized symmetries are not ruled out. No new broad supersymmetric classification is established.

anti_hype_checks: An explicit historical open statement does not prove worldwide novelty today.
A proof using classical ingredients can still answer an open question; classical ingredients alone do not imply the conclusion was already published.
No citation count is used as a significance score or a novelty proof.
Passing scripts or agreement among models do not establish scientific priority, outside acceptance or broad importance.
Three targets are from Tevet2025 and two constructions share a radial-ranking principle; do not advertise five independent breakthroughs.
